extDesc.message: Make every website readable on e-ink: dark themes become light automatically.

settingsHint.message: Applies to every site without its own choice

helpAuto.message: Comfort: turns dark colors light automatically, keeping the site's own look.

helpContrast.message: High contrast: black-and-white mode — white background, black text. Use it when Comfort looks wrong.

helpOff.message: Off: this site goes back to normal.

helpDefault.message: Default: change it in Settings (gear icon). It applies to every site without its own choice.

promoLine.message: PlainApp — the author's open-source app: manage your phone from a browser
